name: Raging Skald (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite(s): A barbarian must be at least 6th level before selecting this rage power.

Benefit: If you unleash a berserker’s cry (with the Berserker’s Cry feat) as you enter a rage or during a rage, the bonus granted increases to +2 and lasts an additional number of rounds equal to your Constitution bonus (if any).
